plan.history_semantics: typed issued_subtask only; last-two texts newline-joined; no completion inferred
plan.data_leakage_boundary: fresh images/states only; source commands only; old heldout/diagnostic observations excluded
plan.label_limit: Monitor truth stays private. Source teacher phase/success never labels new physical progress.
plan.independence_limit: Sibling snapshots and authored history variants are correlated; bank-only changes do not create unique READ inputs.

source_evidence.single_bottle_expert_success: expert_demo_v7 dataset completed=true success=true, upright_hold only; native_success=false; no verify/return
source_evidence.old_highlevel_failures: postfit highlevel_closedloop two heldout diagnostic cases,32 targets each, illegal second READ; excluded from new train

capture_method.left_mapping: right_arm6 negation into left_arm6, right_hand6 copied into left_hand6; inactive right stays fresh initial measured; explicitly not validated as robot expert
capture_method.right_mapping: right reference arm/hand copied, inactive left stays fresh initial measured
capture_method.issued_text: Pick up and hold the sample initially on the SIDE.
capture_method.history_visibility: event appears only after at least one actual target after its issue; executed_until_step clipped to observed snapshot, no future command

must_check: actual SDK24 source/transformed command equals every native target receipt
15-tick exact clock per target, or preserved actual terminal partial clock and mask
state arm motion >0.01rad and >1 saved full-camera RGB hash; inspect montage separately
both workers close and URDF/reference SHA unchanged
no source physical progress reused; new monitor zero is valid failure/attempt evidence
causal histories contain only actual issued windows, actor receives no privileged metrics

split_and_label_constraints: All goals, snapshots, corrections, banks, revision variants and video neighbors from one family belong to its preassigned split.
Old static96, retention anchors/holdout and live highlevel diagnostic episodes are regression-only and cannot enter new train.
256 controls yield train32*9=288 correlated physical contexts; cannot honestly call bank-only variants1000 distinct READ inputs.
READ label must be deduplicated by actual actor-visible prefix+three RGB+state and reject conflicting labels.
Bank conflicts/revisions may vary only through explicit read-first and source-provenance editing; never create new physical events.
Issued instructions document historical commands; they do not prove task completion, successful grasp, verification or return.
Factual physical progress requires monitor event and actual observation/past evidence. Replay motion does not provide multi-stage task success.
resume_semantics: strict script/runtime/config/split/source identity; verify completed NPZ/trace hashes, skip complete shutdown-confirmed episodes; incomplete attempts preserved and restarted from new scene in new folder; no trajectory stitching
